primaryCards.name: Battlefield Dominance
primaryCards.rulesText:
FIRST & SECOND BATTLE ROUND - End of your turn:
  2VP: You control more objectives than your opponent.
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your Command phase (or the end of your turn in the fifth battle round):
  3VP [per instance]: For each objective you control.
  2VP [per instance, cumulative with above]: For each of those objectives (excluding your home objective) if you control your home objective.
primaryCards.whenScored: FIRST & SECOND BATTLE ROUND; SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS

primaryCards.name: Determined Acquisition
primaryCards.rulesText:
ANY BATTLE ROUND - End of your turn:
  2VP [per instance]: For each objective you control that you did not control at the start of the turn (excluding your home objective).
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your Command phase (or the end of your turn in the fifth battle round):
  3VP [per instance]: For each objective you control.
  3VP [per instance, cumulative with above]: For each of those objectives that is within your opponent's territory.
primaryCards.whenScored: ANY BATTLE ROUND; SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS

primaryCards.name: Immovable Object
primaryCards.rulesText:
ANY BATTLE ROUND - End of your turn:
  3VP: You control one or more central objectives.
SECOND TO FOURTH BATTLE ROUND - End of your Command phase:
  5VP [per instance]: For each objective you control (excluding your home objective).
FIFTH BATTLE ROUND - End of your turn:
  5VP [per instance]: For each objective you control (excluding your home objective).
primaryCards.whenScored: ANY BATTLE ROUND; SECOND TO FOURTH BATTLE ROUND; FIFTH BATTLE ROUND

primaryCards.name: Inescapable Dominion
primaryCards.rulesText:
ANY BATTLE ROUND - End of your turn:
  4VP: You control three or more objectives.
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your Command phase (or the end of your turn in the fifth battle round):
  5VP: You control two or more objectives.
  4VP: You control more objectives than your opponent.
END OF BATTLE:
  5VP: You control your opponent's home objective.
primaryCards.whenScored: ANY BATTLE ROUND; SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS; END OF BATTLE

primaryCards.name: Purge and Secure
primaryCards.rulesText:
ANY BATTLE ROUND - End of your turn:
  3VP: One or more enemy units were destroyed this turn by a friendly unit that was within range of one or more objectives.
  OR 3VP: One or more enemy units that started the turn within range of one or more objectives were destroyed this turn.
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your Command phase (or the end of your turn in the fifth battle round):
  4VP [per instance]: For each objective you control (excluding your home objective).
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your turn:
  3VP: You control one or more objectives you did not control at the start of the turn (excluding your home objective).
primaryCards.whenScored: ANY BATTLE ROUND; SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS

primaryCards.name: Consecrate
primaryCards.setupRule: Each time a friendly unit destroys a unit, that friendly unit becomes a consecration unit. At the end of your turn, for each of your consecration units, you can select one objective it is within range of (excluding your home objective) that has not been consecrated. If you do, place one of your operation markers within range of that objective – that objective is consecrated and that unit is no longer a consecration unit.
primaryCards.rulesText:
SPECIAL RULE: Each time a friendly unit destroys a unit, that friendly unit becomes a consecration unit. At the end of your turn, for each of your consecration units, you can select one objective it is within range of (excluding your home objective) that has not been consecrated. If you do, place one of your operation markers within range of that objective – that objective is consecrated and that unit is no longer a consecration unit.
ANY BATTLE ROUND - End of your turn:
  3VP: One or two objectives are consecrated.
  OR 6VP: Three or more objectives are consecrated.
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your Command phase (or the end of your turn in the fifth battle round):
  4VP: You control one or more objectives (excluding your home objective).
  4VP: You control more objectives than your opponent.
END OF BATTLE:
  5VP: Your opponent's home objective is consecrated.
primaryCards.whenScored: ANY BATTLE ROUND; SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS; END OF BATTLE

primaryCards.name: Destroyer's Wrath
primaryCards.rulesText:
ANY BATTLE ROUND - End of your turn:
  3VP: One or more enemy units were destroyed this turn.
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your Command phase (or the end of your turn in the fifth battle round):
  4VP: You control one or more objectives (excluding your home objective).
  6VP: You control more objectives than your opponent.
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your turn:
  4VP: More enemy units were destroyed this turn than friendly units were destroyed in the previous turn.
primaryCards.whenScored: ANY BATTLE ROUND; SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS

primaryCards.name: Meatgrinder
primaryCards.rulesText:
ANY BATTLE ROUND - End of your turn:
  3VP: One or more enemy units were destroyed this turn.
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your Command phase (or the end of your turn in the fifth battle round):
  4VP: You control one or more objectives (excluding your home objective).
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your turn:
  5VP: More enemy units were destroyed this turn than friendly units were destroyed in the previous turn.
  5VP: You control your opponent's home objective.
primaryCards.whenScored: ANY BATTLE ROUND; SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS

primaryCards.name: Punishment
primaryCards.setupRule: START OF YOUR TURN: Select one to three enemy units that are on the battlefield and within range of objectives and/or that destroyed one or more friendly units in the previous turn. If you cannot, select one enemy unit that is on the battlefield. Until the start of your next turn, those units are condemned.
primaryCards.rulesText:
SPECIAL RULE: START OF YOUR TURN: Select one to three enemy units that are on the battlefield and within range of objectives and/or that destroyed one or more friendly units in the previous turn. If you cannot, select one enemy unit that is on the battlefield. Until the start of your next turn, those units are condemned.
ANY BATTLE ROUND - End of a turn:
  5VP: One or more condemned enemy units left the battlefield this turn.
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your Command phase (or the end of your turn in the fifth battle round):
  4VP: You control one or more objectives (excluding your home objective).
  5VP: You control more objectives than your opponent.
END OF BATTLE:
  8VP: You control your opponent's home objective.
primaryCards.whenScored: ANY BATTLE ROUND; SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS; END OF BATTLE

primaryCards.name: Unstoppable Force
primaryCards.rulesText:
ANY BATTLE ROUND - End of your turn:
  3VP: One or more enemy units were destroyed this turn.
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your Command phase (or the end of your turn in the fifth battle round):
  4VP [per instance]: For each objective you control (excluding your home objective).
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your turn:
  3VP: You control one or more objectives you did not control at the start of the turn (excluding your home objective).
END OF BATTLE:
  5VP: You control one or more central objectives.
primaryCards.whenScored: ANY BATTLE ROUND; SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS; END OF BATTLE

primaryCards.name: Gather Intel
primaryCards.setupRule:
OBJECTIVE ACTION - EXTRACT INTELLIGENCE (reverse of card):
  STARTS: Your Shooting phase, from the second battle round onwards.
  UNITS: One unit within range of one objective (excluding your home objective) that does not have any of your operation markers within range of it.
  USE LIMIT: Unlimited. Each unit that starts this action this phase must be within range of a different objective.
  COMPLETES: End of your turn, if your unit controls that objective.
  EFFECT: Place one of your operation markers within range of that objective.
primaryCards.rulesText:
FIRST BATTLE ROUND - End of your turn:
  6VP: You control one or more central objectives.
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your Command phase (or the end of your turn in the fifth battle round):
  4VP: You control one or more objectives (excluding your home objective).
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your turn:
  7VP [per instance]: For each friendly unit that completed the Extract Intelligence action this turn.
END OF BATTLE:
  5VP: Three or more of your operation markers are on the battlefield.
  5VP: One of your operation markers is within range of your opponent's home objective.
primaryCards.whenScored: FIRST BATTLE ROUND; SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS; END OF BATTLE

primaryCards.name: Reconnaissance Sweep
primaryCards.rulesText:
ANY BATTLE ROUND - End of your turn:
  3VP: Three or more friendly units are wholly within three different table quarters and not within 6" of the centre of the battlefield.
  OR 6VP: Four or more friendly units are wholly within four different table quarters and not within 6" of the centre of the battlefield.
ANY BATTLE ROUND - End of your turn:
  1VP [per instance]: For each enemy unit destroyed this turn.
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your Command phase (or the end of your turn in the fifth battle round):
  3VP: You control one or more objectives (excluding your home objective).
primaryCards.whenScored: ANY BATTLE ROUND; SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS

primaryCards.name: Search and Scour
primaryCards.rulesText:
ANY BATTLE ROUND - End of your turn:
  3VP: You control one or more central objectives.
  2VP: One or more enemy units that started the turn within a terrain area are destroyed.
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your Command phase (or the end of your turn in the fifth battle round):
  4VP [per instance]: For each objective you control (excluding your home objective).
END OF BATTLE:
  5VP: No enemy units are wholly within your territory.
primaryCards.whenScored: ANY BATTLE ROUND; SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS; END OF BATTLE

primaryCards.name: Surveil the Foe
primaryCards.setupRule:
Each time a friendly unit ends a move within range of one objective that has any of your opponent's operation markers within range of it, remove those operation markers from the battlefield.
ACTION - SURVEIL THE FOE (reverse of card):
  STARTS: Your Shooting phase.
  UNITS: One friendly unit.
  USE LIMIT: Unlimited.
  COMPLETES: Immediately.
  EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to your unit that has not been surveilled this turn: until the end of the turn, that enemy unit is surveilled.
primaryCards.rulesText:
SPECIAL RULE: Each time a friendly unit ends a move within range of one objective that has any of your opponent's operation markers within range of it, remove those operation markers from the battlefield.
ANY BATTLE ROUND - End of your turn:
  4VP: One or more enemy units were surveilled this turn (see reverse), unless each of those units is within range of one or more objectives that have one or more operation markers within range of them.
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your Command phase (or the end of your turn in the fifth battle round):
  4VP: You control one or more objectives (excluding your home objective).
  4VP: You control more objectives than your opponent.
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your turn:
  5VP: None of your opponent's operation markers are on the battlefield.
primaryCards.whenScored: ANY BATTLE ROUND; SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS

primaryCards.name: Triangulation
primaryCards.setupRule:
OBJECTIVE ACTION - TRIANGULATE (reverse of card):
  STARTS: Your Shooting phase, from the second battle round onwards.
  UNITS: One friendly unit within range of one objective (excluding your home objective).
  USE LIMIT: Once per turn.
  COMPLETES: End of your turn, if your unit controls that objective.
  EFFECT: That objective is triangulated: place one of your operation markers within range of that objective.
primaryCards.rulesText:
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your Command phase (or the end of your turn in the fifth battle round):
  4VP: You control one or more objectives (excluding your home objective).
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your turn:
  3VP: One objective is triangulated (see reverse).
  OR 6VP: Two objectives are triangulated.
  OR 10VP: Three or more objectives are triangulated.
END OF BATTLE:
  10VP: You control four or more objectives.
primaryCards.whenScored: SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS; END OF BATTLE

primaryCards.name: Extract Relic
primaryCards.setupRule:
ACTION - SENSOR SWEEP (reverse of card):
  STARTS: Your Shooting phase.
  UNITS: One friendly unit within range of one central objective.
  USE LIMIT: Once per turn.
  COMPLETES: End of your turn, if your unit controls that objective.
  EFFECT: Your unit performs a sensor sweep: remove one operation marker from the battlefield.
  RESTRICTION: A unit cannot start this action if there is only one operation marker on the battlefield.
primaryCards.rulesText:
ANY BATTLE ROUND - End of your turn:
  4VP: A friendly unit performed a sensor sweep this turn.
  3VP: One or more enemy units that started the turn within range of one or more objectives are destroyed.
  4VP: Only one of your opponent's operation markers is on the battlefield, if one or more of your units are within the same terrain area as that operation marker, and no enemy units are within that terrain area.
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your Command phase (or the end of your turn in the fifth battle round):
  4VP: You control one or more objectives (excluding your home objective).
END OF BATTLE:
  5VP: Only one of your opponent's operation markers is on the battlefield, if one or more of your units are within the same terrain area as that operation marker, and no enemy units are within that terrain area.
primaryCards.whenScored: ANY BATTLE ROUND; SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS; END OF BATTLE

primaryCards.name: Sabotage
primaryCards.setupRule:
ACTION - SABOTAGE (reverse of card):
  STARTS: Your Shooting phase.
  UNITS: One unit within range of one objective (excluding your home objective).
  USE LIMIT: Unlimited. Each unit that starts this action this phase must be within range of a different objective.
  COMPLETES: End of your turn, if that unit controls that objective.
  EFFECT: Your unit commits sabotage.
primaryCards.rulesText:
ANY BATTLE ROUND - End of your turn:
  3VP [per instance]: For each friendly unit that committed sabotage this turn (see reverse).
  2VP [per instance, cumulative with above]: For each of those units that is within range of one or more objectives in your opponent's territory.
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your Command phase (or the end of your turn in the fifth battle round):
  4VP: You control one or more objectives (excluding your home objective).
primaryCards.whenScored: ANY BATTLE ROUND; SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS

primaryCards.name: Secure Asset
primaryCards.setupRule:
ACTION - SECURE ASSET (reverse of card):
  STARTS: Your Shooting phase.
  UNITS: One friendly unit within range of one objective (excluding your home objective).
  USE LIMIT: Once per turn.
  COMPLETES: End of your turn, if your unit controls that objective.
  EFFECT: Your unit secures the asset.
primaryCards.rulesText:
ANY BATTLE ROUND - End of your turn:
  4VP: A friendly unit secured the asset this turn (see reverse).
  2VP: One or more enemy units that started the turn within range of one or more central objectives are destroyed.
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your Command phase (or the end of your turn in the fifth battle round):
  4VP: You control one or more objectives (excluding your home objective).
  4VP: You control three or more objectives.
primaryCards.whenScored: ANY BATTLE ROUND; SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS

primaryCards.name: Vanguard Operation
primaryCards.setupRule:
ACTION - VANGUARD OPERATION (reverse of card):
  STARTS: Your Shooting phase.
  UNITS: One friendly unit within one terrain area that is within your opponent's territory.
  USE LIMIT: Once per turn.
  COMPLETES: End of your turn, if no enemy units are within that terrain area.
  EFFECT: Your unit performs a vanguard operation.
primaryCards.rulesText:
ANY BATTLE ROUND - End of your turn:
  4VP: A friendly unit performed a vanguard operation this turn.
  2VP: One or more enemy units were destroyed this turn.
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your Command phase (or the end of your turn in the fifth battle round):
  4VP: You control one or more objectives (excluding your home objective).
END OF BATTLE:
  10VP: You control your opponent's home objective.
primaryCards.whenScored: ANY BATTLE ROUND; SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS; END OF BATTLE

primaryCards.name: Vital Link
primaryCards.setupRule:
ACTION - MAINTAIN CONTROL (reverse of card):
  STARTS: Your Shooting phase.
  UNITS: One friendly unit within range of one central objective.
  USE LIMIT: Once per turn.
  COMPLETES: End of your turn, if your unit controls that objective.
  EFFECT: Place one of your operation markers within range of that objective.
primaryCards.rulesText:
ANY BATTLE ROUND - End of your turn:
  2VP: You control one or more central objectives.
  1VP [per instance, cumulative with above]: For each of your operation markers within range of one of those objectives (see reverse).
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your Command phase (or the end of your turn in the fifth battle round):
  4VP: You control one or more objectives (excluding your home objective).
  4VP [cumulative with above]: One or more of those objectives is a central objective.
END OF BATTLE:
  10VP: You control your opponent's home objective.
primaryCards.whenScored: ANY BATTLE ROUND; SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS; END OF BATTLE

primaryCards.name: Death Trap
primaryCards.setupRule:
ACTION - BOOBY TRAP (reverse of card):
  STARTS: Your Shooting phase.
  UNITS: One friendly unit within range of one objective (excluding your home objective) or within one terrain area that is not within your deployment zone, that you have not yet trapped.
  USE LIMIT: Unlimited. Each unit that starts this action this phase must be within a different terrain area.
  COMPLETES: Immediately.
  EFFECT: That terrain area is trapped: place one of your operation markers within that terrain area.
primaryCards.rulesText:
ANY BATTLE ROUND - End of your turn:
  2VP [per instance]: For each terrain area trapped this turn.
  3VP [per instance, cumulative with above]: For each of those terrain areas that is an objective.
ANY BATTLE ROUND - End of your turn:
  3VP: One or more enemy units that started the turn within a terrain area were destroyed, if that terrain area is trapped.
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your Command phase (or the end of your turn in the fifth battle round):
  4VP: You control one or more objectives (excluding your home objective).
primaryCards.whenScored: ANY BATTLE ROUND; SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS

primaryCards.name: Delaying Action
primaryCards.rulesText:
ANY BATTLE ROUND - End of your turn:
  2VP [per instance]: For each enemy unit destroyed this turn.
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your Command phase (or the end of your turn in the fifth battle round):
  4VP: You control one or more objectives (excluding home objectives).
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your turn:
  3VP: You control one or more central objectives and one or more expansion objectives.
primaryCards.whenScored: ANY BATTLE ROUND; SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS

primaryCards.name: Locate and Deny
primaryCards.setupRule:
START OF THE BATTLE: Select five terrain areas not within your deployment zone; for each one, place one of your operation markers within it. If you cannot, do so for each terrain area that is not within your deployment zone.
ACTION - SENSOR SWEEP (reverse of card):
  STARTS: Your Shooting phase.
  UNITS: One friendly unit within range of one central objective.
  USE LIMIT: Once per turn.
  COMPLETES: End of your turn, if your unit controls that objective.
  EFFECT: Your unit performs a sensor sweep: remove one operation marker from the battlefield.
  RESTRICTION: A unit cannot start this action if there is only one operation marker on the battlefield.
primaryCards.rulesText:
SPECIAL RULE: START OF THE BATTLE: Select five terrain areas not within your deployment zone; for each one, place one of your operation markers within it. If you cannot, do so for each terrain area that is not within your deployment zone.
ANY BATTLE ROUND - End of your turn:
  4VP: One or more enemy units that started the turn within range of one or more objectives are destroyed.
  4VP: Only one of your operation markers is on the battlefield, if one or more of your units are within the same terrain area as that marker, and no enemy units are within that terrain area.
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your Command phase (or the end of your turn in the fifth battle round):
  4VP: You control one or more objectives (excluding your home objective).
END OF BATTLE:
  5VP: Only one of your operation markers is on the battlefield, if one or more of your units are within the same terrain area as that marker, and no enemy units are within that terrain area.
primaryCards.whenScored: ANY BATTLE ROUND; SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS; END OF BATTLE

primaryCards.name: Outmanoeuvre
primaryCards.rulesText:
ANY BATTLE ROUND - End of your turn:
  10VP: You control your opponent's home objective.
FIRST BATTLE ROUND - End of your turn:
  4VP [per instance]: For each objective you control (excluding your home objective).
SECOND & THIRD BATTLE ROUND - End of your Command phase:
  5VP [per instance]: For each objective you control (excluding your home objective).
FOURTH BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your turn:
  6VP [per instance]: For each objective you control (excluding your home objective).
primaryCards.whenScored: ANY BATTLE ROUND; FIRST BATTLE ROUND; SECOND & THIRD BATTLE ROUND; FOURTH BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS

primaryCards.name: Smoke and Mirrors
primaryCards.setupRule:
ACTION - DECOY (reverse of card):
  STARTS: Your Shooting phase.
  UNITS: One friendly unit within range of one objective (excluding your home objective) that is not decoyed.
  USE LIMIT: Unlimited. Each unit that starts this action this phase must be within range of a different objective.
  COMPLETES: End of your turn, if your unit controls that objective.
  EFFECT: That objective is decoyed: place one of your operation markers within range of that objective.
primaryCards.rulesText:
ANY BATTLE ROUND - End of your turn:
  2VP [per instance]: For each objective that is decoyed (see reverse).
  2VP [per instance, cumulative with above]: For each of those objectives that is within your opponent's territory.
SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS - End of your Command phase (or the end of your turn in the fifth battle round):
  4VP: You control one or more objectives (excluding your home objective).
END OF BATTLE:
  10VP: Four or more objectives are decoyed.
primaryCards.whenScored: ANY BATTLE ROUND; SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS; END OF BATTLE

secondaryCards.name: A Grievous Blow
secondaryCards.rulesText: Header: SECONDARY - FIXED / TACTICAL. WHEN DRAWN: if there are no enemy units with a starting strength of 13 or more on the battlefield, you can discard this card and draw one new Secondary Mission card. FIXED block (any battle round, end of a turn): score 4 VP for each enemy unit with a starting strength of 13 or more that is destroyed this turn. TACTICAL block (any battle round, end of a turn): score 5 VP if one or more enemy units with a starting strength of 13 or more were destroyed this turn.
secondaryCards.vp: Fixed: 4 VP per qualifying unit; Tactical: 5 VP flat
secondaryCards.whenScored: End of a turn (any battle round)
secondaryCards.discardRules: When drawn: if no enemy units with starting strength 13+ are on the battlefield, you can discard this card and draw one new Secondary Mission card.

secondaryCards.name: A Tempting Target
secondaryCards.rulesText: Header: SECONDARY - TACTICAL. WHEN DRAWN: your opponent selects one objective (excluding home objectives) within No Man's Land to be your tempting target. TACTICAL block (any battle round, end of your turn): score 5 VP if you control your tempting target.
secondaryCards.whenScored: End of your turn (any battle round)

secondaryCards.name: Assassination
secondaryCards.rulesText: Header: SECONDARY - FIXED / TACTICAL. FIXED block (any battle round, while this card is active): score 3 VP for each enemy CHARACTER model destroyed this turn, plus (cumulative) +1 VP for each of those models with a Wounds characteristic of 4 or more. TACTICAL block (any battle round, end of either player's turn): score 5 VP if one or more enemy CHARACTER models were destroyed this turn, OR score 5 VP if all enemy CHARACTER models have been destroyed during the battle.
secondaryCards.vp: Fixed: 3 VP per CHARACTER model (+1 VP cumulative if W4+); Tactical: 5 VP
secondaryCards.whenScored: Fixed: while this card is active (any battle round); Tactical: end of either player's turn

secondaryCards.name: Beacon
secondaryCards.rulesText: Header: SECONDARY - TACTICAL. WHEN DRAWN: select one friendly unit on the battlefield, or embarked within a TRANSPORT on the battlefield, to be your beacon unit. TACTICAL block (any battle round; end of your opponent's turn or the end of the fifth battle round, whichever comes first): score 3 VP if your beacon unit is on the battlefield and not within your deployment zone, OR score 5 VP if your beacon unit is on the battlefield and not within your territory.
secondaryCards.whenScored: End of your opponent's turn or end of the fifth battle round, whichever comes first (any battle round)

secondaryCards.name: Behind Enemy Lines
secondaryCards.rulesText: Header: SECONDARY - TACTICAL. WHEN DRAWN: if it is the first battle round, you can draw one new Secondary Mission card and shuffle this card back into your Secondary Mission deck. TACTICAL block (any battle round, end of your turn): score 3 VP for each friendly unit (excluding AIRCRAFT and battle-shocked units) wholly within your opponent's deployment zone. Maximum 5 VP.
secondaryCards.vp: 3 VP per qualifying unit, max 5 VP
secondaryCards.whenScored: End of your turn (any battle round)
secondaryCards.discardRules: When drawn: if it is the first battle round, you can draw one new Secondary Mission card and shuffle this card back into your Secondary Mission deck.

secondaryCards.name: Bring it Down
secondaryCards.rulesText: Header: SECONDARY - FIXED / TACTICAL. WHEN DRAWN: if there are no enemy models with a Wounds characteristic of 10 or more on the battlefield, you can discard this card and draw one new Secondary Mission card. FIXED block (any battle round, end of a turn): score 4 VP for each enemy model with a Wounds characteristic of 10 or more that is destroyed this turn. TACTICAL block (any battle round, end of a turn): score 5 VP if one or more enemy models with a Wounds characteristic of 10 or more were destroyed this turn.
secondaryCards.vp: Fixed: 4 VP per qualifying model; Tactical: 5 VP flat
secondaryCards.whenScored: End of a turn (any battle round)
secondaryCards.discardRules: When drawn: if no enemy models with a Wounds characteristic of 10+ are on the battlefield, you can discard this card and draw one new Secondary Mission card.

secondaryCards.name: Burden of Trust
secondaryCards.rulesText: Header: SECONDARY - TACTICAL. WHEN DRAWN / START OF YOUR TURN: for each objective, you can select one friendly unit on the battlefield to guard that objective. Until the start of your next turn, while that unit is within range of that objective and while you control that objective, that objective is guarded by your army. TACTICAL block (any battle round; end of your opponent's turn or the end of the fifth battle round, whichever comes first): score 2 VP for each objective guarded by your army. Maximum 5 VP.
secondaryCards.vp: 2 VP per guarded objective, max 5 VP
secondaryCards.whenScored: End of your opponent's turn or end of the fifth battle round, whichever comes first (any battle round)

secondaryCards.name: Centre Ground
secondaryCards.rulesText: Header: SECONDARY - TACTICAL. TACTICAL block (any battle round, end of your turn): score 3 VP if one or more friendly units (excluding AIRCRAFT and battle-shocked units) are within 3" of the centre of the battlefield and no enemy units are within 3" of the centre of the battlefield, OR score 5 VP if one or more friendly units (excluding AIRCRAFT and battle-shocked units) are within 3" of the centre of the battlefield and no enemy units are within 6" of the centre of the battlefield.
secondaryCards.whenScored: End of your turn (any battle round)

secondaryCards.name: Cleanse
secondaryCards.rulesText: Header: SECONDARY - TACTICAL. WHEN DRAWN: if the Plunder Secondary Mission is active for you, you can draw one new Secondary Mission card and shuffle this card back into your Secondary Mission deck. CLEANSE (Objective Action) - STARTS: your Shooting phase. UNITS: one friendly unit within range of one objective (excluding your home objective). USE LIMIT: unlimited; each unit that starts this action this phase must be within range of a different objective. COMPLETES: end of your turn, if that unit is controlling that objective. EFFECT: that objective is cleansed by your army. TACTICAL block (any battle round, end of your turn): score 2 VP if one objective was cleansed by your army this turn, OR score 5 VP if two or more objectives were cleansed by your army this turn.
secondaryCards.whenScored: End of your turn (any battle round)
secondaryCards.discardRules: When drawn: if the Plunder Secondary Mission is active for you, you can draw one new Secondary Mission card and shuffle this card back into your Secondary Mission deck.

secondaryCards.name: Defend Stronghold
secondaryCards.rulesText: Header: SECONDARY - TACTICAL. WHEN DRAWN: if it is the first battle round, draw one new Secondary Mission card and shuffle this card back into your Secondary Mission deck (mandatory). TACTICAL block (second battle round onwards; end of your opponent's turn or the end of the fifth battle round, whichever comes first): score 3 VP if you control your home objective, plus (cumulative) +2 VP if no enemy units are within your deployment zone.
secondaryCards.vp: 3 VP, +2 VP cumulative (5 VP total possible)
secondaryCards.whenScored: Second battle round onwards; end of your opponent's turn or end of the fifth battle round, whichever comes first
secondaryCards.discardRules: When drawn: if it is the first battle round, draw one new Secondary Mission card and shuffle this card back into your Secondary Mission deck (mandatory, not optional).

secondaryCards.name: Display of Might
secondaryCards.rulesText: Header: SECONDARY - TACTICAL. TACTICAL block 1 (any battle round, end of your turn): score 2 VP if there are more friendly units than enemy units (excluding AIRCRAFT and battle-shocked units) wholly within No Man's Land. TACTICAL block 2 (any battle round, end of your opponent's turn): score 5 VP if there are more friendly units than enemy units (excluding AIRCRAFT and battle-shocked units) wholly within No Man's Land.
secondaryCards.whenScored: End of your turn (2 VP) and end of your opponent's turn (5 VP), any battle round

secondaryCards.name: Engage on All Fronts
secondaryCards.rulesText: Header: SECONDARY - FIXED / TACTICAL. Definition: if one or more friendly units (excluding AIRCRAFT and battle-shocked units) are wholly within a table quarter, and those units are not within 6" of the centre of the battlefield, you have a presence in that table quarter. FIXED block (any battle round, end of your turn): score 2 VP if you have a presence in three table quarters, OR 4 VP if you have a presence in four table quarters. TACTICAL block (any battle round, end of your turn): score 3 VP if you have a presence in three table quarters, OR 5 VP if you have a presence in four table quarters.
secondaryCards.vp: Fixed: 2 or 4 VP; Tactical: 3 or 5 VP
secondaryCards.whenScored: End of your turn (any battle round)

secondaryCards.name: Forward Position
secondaryCards.rulesText: Header: SECONDARY - TACTICAL. WHEN DRAWN: if it is the first battle round, you can draw one new Secondary Mission card and shuffle this card back into your Secondary Mission deck. TACTICAL block (any battle round, end of your turn): score 5 VP if you control your opponent's home objective and/or each expansion objective.
secondaryCards.whenScored: End of your turn (any battle round)
secondaryCards.discardRules: When drawn: if it is the first battle round, you can draw one new Secondary Mission card and shuffle this card back into your Secondary Mission deck.

secondaryCards.name: No Prisoners
secondaryCards.rulesText: Header: SECONDARY - TACTICAL. TACTICAL block (any battle round, end of a turn): score 2 VP for each enemy unit destroyed this turn. Maximum 5 VP.
secondaryCards.vp: 2 VP per enemy unit destroyed, max 5 VP
secondaryCards.whenScored: End of a turn (any battle round)

secondaryCards.name: Outflank
secondaryCards.rulesText: Header: SECONDARY - TACTICAL. TACTICAL block (any battle round, end of your turn): score 3 VP if one or more friendly units (excluding AIRCRAFT and battle-shocked units) are within 6" of one or more battlefield edges and not within your territory, OR score 5 VP if two or more friendly units (excluding AIRCRAFT and battle-shocked units) are within 6" of opposite battlefield edges and one or more of those units is not within your territory. Designer's Note: opposite battlefield edges are those parallel to each other.
secondaryCards.whenScored: End of your turn (any battle round)

secondaryCards.name: Overwhelming Force
secondaryCards.rulesText: Header: SECONDARY - TACTICAL. TACTICAL block (any battle round, end of a turn): score 3 VP for each enemy unit that started the turn within range of one or more objectives and is destroyed. Maximum 5 VP.
secondaryCards.vp: 3 VP per qualifying unit, max 5 VP
secondaryCards.whenScored: End of a turn (any battle round)

secondaryCards.name: Plunder
secondaryCards.rulesText: Header: SECONDARY - TACTICAL. WHEN DRAWN: if the Cleanse Secondary Mission is active for you, you can draw one new Secondary Mission card and shuffle this card back into your Secondary Mission deck. PLUNDER (Objective Action) - STARTS: your Shooting phase. UNITS: one unit within a terrain area that is not within your territory. USE LIMIT: once per turn. COMPLETES: immediately. EFFECT: that terrain area is plundered. TACTICAL block (any battle round, end of your turn): score 5 VP if a terrain area was plundered this turn.
secondaryCards.whenScored: End of your turn (any battle round)
secondaryCards.discardRules: When drawn: if the Cleanse Secondary Mission is active for you, you can draw one new Secondary Mission card and shuffle this card back into your Secondary Mission deck.

secondaryCards.name: Secure No Man's Land
secondaryCards.rulesText: Header: SECONDARY - TACTICAL. TACTICAL block (any battle round, end of your turn): score 5 VP if you control two or more objectives within No Man's Land (excluding your home objective).
secondaryCards.whenScored: End of your turn (any battle round)

dispositions.name: Take and Hold
dispositions.rulesText: FORCE DISPOSITION - YOUR STANCE: TAKE AND HOLD. The card is a lookup table (columns: YOU / MISSION / OPPONENT): find your opponent's Force Disposition symbol on this card; the Primary Mission listed beside that symbol is YOUR Primary Mission, which describes how you score VP. If your opponent's Force Disposition is Take and Hold, your Primary Mission is Battlefield Dominance. If your opponent's Force Disposition is Purge the Foe, your Primary Mission is Immovable Object. If your opponent's Force Disposition is Disruption, your Primary Mission is Determined Acquisition. If your opponent's Force Disposition is Reconnaissance, your Primary Mission is Purge and Secure. If your opponent's Force Disposition is Priority Assets, your Primary Mission is Inescapable Dominion. (Per the Warhammer Event Mission Sequence: once a player has mustered their army, they select one Force Disposition card available to them - determined by their selected detachments - and record it on their roster. Each player determines their own Primary Mission independently from their own card, so the two players may be playing different Primary Missions in the same game.)

sequence.title: Before the event
text: Before attending a Warhammer Event, each player completes the following step:

sequence.title: Muster Armies
text: Muster armies as described in the Warhammer 40,000 app, with the following exception: once they have mustered their army, a player selects one Force Disposition card available to them and records that on their roster.
A Warhammer Event battle is then waged by completing the remaining steps below:

sequence.title: Determine Mission
text: Each player finds their opponent's Force Disposition symbol on their Force Disposition card. The Primary Mission that is listed below that symbol is that player's Primary Mission, which describes how to score VP.

sequence.title: Determine A Layout
text: Each combination of Primary Missions has three recommended layouts, labelled A, B and C. These can be found in the Warhammer 40,000 app and at the end of this companion. As directed by the Warhammer Event organiser, the players either use the layout specified or randomly determine which of these layouts to use.

sequence.title: Create The Battlefield
text: Missions are played on rectangular battlefields 44" by 60" in size. Players set up the terrain areas as shown in the selected layout, then set up terrain features on those terrain areas as shown in the selected layout.

sequence.title: Determine Attacker And Defender
text: Players look at the selected layout and agree which edges of the battlefield the players have set up correspond with the Attacker's and Defender's battlefield edges labelled on the card. Roll off: the winner decides who will be the Attacker and who will be the Defender.

sequence.title: Select Secondary Missions
text: Secondary Mission cards detail additional ways to score VP. Players now secretly note down whether they will use Tactical or Fixed Secondary Missions. If using Fixed Missions, they also note down which two Fixed Missions they will use (see below). Players then reveal these decisions.
Fixed Missions

Fixed Missions are those marked with the symbol shown on the left. If you are using Fixed Missions, display your selected Fixed Mission cards face-up. Fixed Missions cannot be discarded and are active for you throughout the battle.
Tactical Missions
If you are using Tactical Missions, shuffle your Secondary Mission deck face-down.
At the start of your Command phase, draw two Secondary Missions face-up from your Secondary Missions deck; these Secondary Missions are active for you.
(Once per battle) At the end of your Command phase, you can spend 1CP to discard one of your active Secondary Mission cards and draw one new Secondary Mission card.
Achieving Secondary Missions
At the end of each player's turn, each player does the following, starting with the player whose turn it is:

First, if you met the conditions on one or more Secondary Missions, you can gain the VP specified on that card. If you do, and if you are using Tactical Secondary Missions, discard that Secondary Mission - it is achieved.
Then, if it is your turn and you are using Tactical Secondary Missions, you can discard one or more of your active Secondary Missions. If you do, you gain 1CP.

sequence.title: Declare Battle Formations
text: Players secretly note down, in order:
Which of their units will start the battle embarked within which TRANSPORTS.
Which of their units will start the battle in strategic reserves.
Players then reveal these decisions.

sequence.title: Deploy Armies
text: Players take it in turns to set up their units (excluding those in strategic reserves) one at a time, wholly within their deployment zone, starting with the Defender. If you set up a TITANIC unit when it is your turn to set up a unit, skip your next turn to set up a unit. Once you have finished setting up your units, if your opponent has any units that have not been set up, they set up those units.

sequence.title: Redeploy Units
text: Some rules let you redeploy certain units after both armies are deployed. Unless otherwise stated, you resolve those rules in this step. Players alternate resolving any such rules, starting with the Attacker. Units placed in strategic reserves in this step do not count towards the combined points value of your strategic reserves units.

sequence.title: Determine First Turn
text: Roll off: the winner takes the first turn.

sequence.title: Resolve Pre-battle Rules
text: Players alternate resolving any pre-battle rules units from their army may have, starting with the player who will take the first turn.

sequence.title: Begin The Battle
text: The first battle round begins.

sequence.title: End The Battle
text: The battle ends after five battle rounds have been completed. Even if you have no models remaining in your army at the start of your turn, players continue to play out their turns until the battle ends.

sequence.title: Determine Victor
text: Each player scores 10VP if their army is painted to a Battle Ready standard. At the end of the battle, the player with the most VP is the victor. If the players are tied, the battle is a draw. The maximum VP that can be scored from each source of VP is listed below. Any VP you score in excess of these maximums are ignored.

PRIMARY MISSION 45VP - Up to 15VP per battle round. SECONDARY MISSIONS 45VP - Up to 15VP per battle round*. BATTLE READY ARMY 10VP. (* In addition, you can gain a maximum of 20VP per Fixed Secondary Mission card.)
